create_schema_basic: create a Schema from a dictionary mapping column names to Polars data types
create_schema_arrow: create a Schema from a PyArrow schema object using the __arrow_c_schema__ interface
test_schema_equality: test two Schema objects for equality by comparing column names and data types
test_schema_names_dtypes: test a Schema to retrieve its column names and associated data types as lists
build_schema_to_frame: build an empty DataFrame or LazyFrame from a Schema definition
summarize_schema_properties: summarize a Schema by getting its length, names, dtypes, and Python type mappings
refactor_schema_to_arrow: refactor a Schema to export it as a PyArrow schema with optional compatibility level
